name: comp-290
title: Error Notification Card
description: A rounded notification card for a failed action. A red alert circle sits beside a bold headline and grey explanation, with a light action button below and an X in the corner.
use: An error needs a short explanation plus a route to more detail without blocking the page.
avoid: Nothing is wired: the close and action buttons are inert and the card cannot stack or reposition.
a11y: The close button is named and both controls take focus, but neither does anything and the card has no live-region role. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A bordered card with a soft shadow holds a red circled exclamation, a bold short sentence, two muted lines of explanation, and a small light-filled Learn more button. A grey close cross sits at the top right.
behaves: Hovering the Learn more button or the close cross shades them, but nothing else happens: the card has no dismiss or follow-up action wired up.
customise: The headline, explanation and button label are written into the file; width, padding and the red icon colour are fixed, and it takes no props.
weight: light: A card with a couple of buttons and no animation beyond hover fades.
